description: TEMPLATE ONLY - placeholder values, not real match data. Copy to eval_labels/<your-clip>.json (git-ignored) and replace every value with the coach's labels. Field reference: events[].timeSec = event time in video seconds; events[].promptCode = TTA event promptCode from the match snapshot (e.g. EVT_01_G_POS); events[].periodNumber = optional match period; events[].capNumber = cap number of the acting tracked-team player, or null when the event has no tracked-team actor; events[].notes = free text; anchors[].type = PeriodStart | PeriodEnd | StoppageStart | StoppageEnd; anchors[].periodNumber = optional period. Time matching uses --tolerance-sec (default 3).

events.notes: placeholder: conceded goal, no tracked-team actor
